changed.where: Pad page, a mapping row, the line under a mouse source, the Steer picker

changed.english: Always lets the mouse steer at all times. While Held and Center lets it steer only while the Steer Input is held, then brings it back to center, by Centering where the source has one and at once where it has none. While Held and Stay lets it steer only while the input is held and leaves it where it was let go. Toggle turns steering on or off with each press of the Steer Input. So one mouse can steer and look around.
changed.where: Pad page, a mapping row, the line under a mouse source, hover help on Steer

changed.english: How long Spring takes to bring the wheel 95% of the way back. 0 centers it at once. From Telemetry takes this long from near center at 100 km/h on a dry road.
changed.where: Pad page, a mapping row, the line under a mouse source, hover help on Return Time

changed.english: Off holds the wheel where the hand left it. Spring brings it back over Return Time. From Telemetry pulls it back as a car’s steering does at the game’s speed and grip: steeply near center and softer further out, still at a standstill, firmer with speed, light when the tires slide. With no game sending telemetry it pulls as at 100 km/h on a dry road. From the Game’s Force lets a virtual wheel’s own force feedback turn it.
changed.where: Pad page, a mapping row, the line under a mouse source, hover help on Centering

changed.english: Evens out a mouse that reports unevenly. The stick trails the hand by about this long. 0 is off.
changed.where: Pad page, a mapping row, the line under a mouse source, hover help on Smoothing

changed.english: Per-source cursor sensitivity. 1.0 reaches full stick deflection at 10% of the width of the pointer’s monitor from its center. Values above 1.0 reach full deflection with less cursor travel. Values below 1.0 need more.
changed.where: Pad page, a mapping row, the line under a mouse source (Mouse Position), hover help on Sensitivity

changed.english: How far the mouse or the wheel moves from center to full lock, in the counts it reports. A higher number steers finer and takes more hand travel.
changed.where: Pad page, a mapping row, the line under a mouse source, hover help on Travel to Full Lock

changed.english: The button that lets the mouse steer, on the same device as the source. With none picked, the mouse always steers.
